tools.name: browser_context
tools.description: Use when you need a browser: open or close one for this agent. "fresh" starts an empty throwaway profile; "mine" opens a private Edge/Chrome copy of the person's profile without saved logins, whose snapshots and screenshots hide typed values. Both run in the background and leave the person's windows alone. A failed mine open never authorizes computer control, attaching to the person's browser, interactive sign-in, or switching identity or transport. Keep the contextId and close when done.

action.description: open starts a new browser and returns its contextId; close shuts it and deletes its folder.

browser.description: open only. fresh (default): empty legacy profile, outside copied-profile protection. mine: private copy of the person's profile with no saved-login stores, deleted on close. A failed mine open carries COPY_SOURCE_PERMISSION (the OS refused access; Desk cannot grant it) or COPY_SOURCE_POLICY (source qualification failed). The open reply's runtime names the Desk version and plugin root that ran.

contextId.description: close only. The contextId that open returned.

tools.name: browser_command
tools.description: Use when you drive an owned browser context: run one command with `args`, a list of literal strings, never shell. Start with ["goto","https://example.com"] or ["snapshot"], then act on current refs; on AUTH_SNAPSHOT_INVALIDATED snapshot again. Every reply says where the tab is and whether the action navigated or changed the page. eval and run-code return what the script returns, unredacted. Open and close only through browser_context.

contextId.description: The contextId that browser_context open returned.

args.description: The command and its arguments, for example ["snapshot"] or ["fill","e4","text"]. In mine the commands are: snapshot [--interactive|--save], find <text>, goto <url>, go-back, go-forward, reload, wait [<seconds>|<text>|--gone <text>], click/dblclick/hover/check/uncheck <ref>, fill/type <ref> <text>, press [<ref>] <key>, select <ref> <value>, mousewheel <dx> <dy>, resize <w> <h>, screenshot [<ref>] [--full], tab-list, tab-new, tab-select <n>, tab-close [<n>], eval <function or expression> [<ref>], run-code <async function of page>, console [<level>], keydown/keyup <key>, mousemove <x> <y>, mousedown/mouseup [<button>], upload <ref> <file>..., dialog-accept [<text>], dialog-dismiss, localstorage-* and sessionstorage-* (list, get, set, delete, clear). Act on a ref soon after its snapshot. To type into a rich-text editor, fill its textbox ref, then press Enter; typed.verified says whether it holds the text. screenshot saves a masked PNG in the evidence folder, which stays after close, and returns its path. A transient error page: ["reload"], then wait. Fresh keeps the legacy CLI commands.
